analysis: Rebuilt the closest option around lifespan development, social psychology, attention and memory, language processing, educational prevention and empirical methods. Youth Resilience to Extremism develops teacher-training resources and a youth toolkit, and Rhetoric in Action involves teaching speaking with primary-school children. These give concrete educational practice alongside qualitative inquiry, statistical models and evidence synthesis. Policy and public economics provide bounded context for education systems and investment.

The digital option combines cognition and developmental study with programming, data science, machine learning, neural networks and AI ethics. Added Data Science before Machine Learning and Youth Resilience to Extremism as a substantive educational application. Cognitive and language-processing courses support inquiry into learning, while the computational sequence supplies general analytical tools. The option does not promise a dedicated curriculum in instructional software, virtual reality or educational evaluation.

Rebuilt the organisational option around leadership, adult development, social psychology, communication and empirical inquiry. Digital strategy, data science, machine learning and AI ethics address workplace change and evidence. The former coding-heavy palette did not adequately implement workplace learning. Personal Leadership, Leadership Communication, Negotiation, Leading Under Pressure, lifespan development and cognition now carry its human-development centre. General business and data courses are complementary.

All three complete schedules pass current offerings, earlier formal prerequisites, 24 unique courses, four per term and at least six advanced courses. The three centres and pairwise credit differences remain substantive. The revised alignment contains bounded shared content and methods, while specialist curriculum, instruction, future-learning design and the empirical thesis remain unpaired. Optional UCR research is additional to the scheduled 180 EC.

alignment.rationale: Both introduce empirical research design, measurement and analysis.
Both teach qualitative research design, data collection and interpretation. UvA focuses on educational questions.
Both develop statistical skills for social or behavioural research. UCR also applies multivariable models.
Both consider development and learning. UCR studies development across life, while UvA introduces pedagogical and educational science.
Both use ethical reasoning and argument. UvA focuses specifically on educational ideals and rights.
Both study policy decisions and processes. UCR uses a general policy case, while UvA studies the education system.
Both examine inequality and social institutions. UCR includes education among its social contexts, while UvA studies educational systems in depth.
Both use economic reasoning to study public investment and social outcomes. UCR includes education spending among its applications.
Both develop empirical research through practical work. UCR uses surveys about leadership and social experience, while UvA studies education.
Both study organisations, people and change. UvA applies organisational theory to learning and education.
